data.name: Jibreela
data.gender_notes: Jibreela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jibreela is the name of an angelic being in Islamic tradition, meaning 'the gentle one'. She is believed to bring comfort and protection to those who call upon her. The name Jibreela carries the meaning “The gentle one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jibreela usually hope their child will grow to embody the gentle one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Jibreela belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The gentle one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibreela total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Jibreela
in_english.meaning: Angel of God, Messenger of Divine Revelation
in_english.long_meaning: Jibreela is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies 'Angel of God' or 'Messenger of Divine Revelation'. In Islamic tradition, Jibreela (also known as Gabriel) is the name of an angel who serves as a messenger of God. He is often referred to as 'Ruh al-Amin' (the Trustworthy Spirit). Jibreela plays a crucial role in Islamic theology, particularly in the delivery of divine revelations to prophets. The name is mentioned multiple times in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across Muslim communities worldwide.
